evals.prompt: 帮我把 `.issue-flow/cases/OMMUSIC-3397323/` 这个 case 的处理结果同步到 overmind。能关就关，关不了至少把问题原因、解决方案、测试方法这些字段补齐。
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the resolved case artifacts, discovers editable Overmind fields before writing, performs a best-effort sync through Overmind MCP, and reports the actual execution result without creating local sync files.
expectations: The workflow treats the case workspace as the source of truth.
The workflow separates field updates from close attempts.
The result explicitly reports partial success or manual follow-up when some fields cannot be updated.
The workflow does not create integrations/overmind/sync.yaml by default.

evals.prompt: 重新提交一下这个 BUG 的处理状态，刚才 overmind 说状态字段失败了。先看看哪些字段可编辑，再补齐能补齐的字段。
evals.expected_output: The skill reacts to the prior failure by checking editability first, avoids assuming status is writable, and retries only the supported updates.
expectations: The workflow requires editable-field discovery before enum or status writes.
The workflow records failed and skipped fields rather than hiding them.
The workflow avoids repeating the same failing close mutation without new evidence.

evals.prompt: 不要把这个流程塞进 issue-resolve。请设计一个插件型 skill，从 resolution.xml 和 verification.md 推导 overmind 更新内容，并直接调用 overmind mcp 执行。
evals.expected_output: The skill is positioned as a plugin-style post-resolve integration, directly uses Overmind MCP for execution, and does not require changes to issue-flow-core lifecycle semantics.
expectations: The skill is explicitly described as outside the main issue-flow-core stages.
The design keeps status.yaml authoritative for case lifecycle.
The design does not create local sync artifacts by default.
The design stops plainly if Overmind MCP is unavailable.
